---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the CodeNow desktop app or wiki is broken or behaving unexpectedly
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Describe the bug
A clear, concise description of what's wrong.

## To reproduce
1. Open CodeNow…
2. Click on…
3. See error / wrong behavior

## Expected behavior
What you thought should happen instead.

## Screenshots / video
If applicable, attach a screenshot or screen recording. Cmd+Shift+4 on macOS captures a region; Cmd+Shift+5 records video.

## Environment
- CodeNow version: (top-right pill in the IDE shows this — e.g. v0.1.15)
- OS: (macOS / Windows / Linux + version)
- Mac arch: (Apple Silicon / Intel — `uname -m`)
- AI provider you're using: (Claude / Codex / Gemini / Aider / Copilot / none)
- Project type: (TypeScript / Python / agent kit / etc.)

## Additional context
Anything else — error messages from the DevTools console (Cmd+Opt+I), terminal output, or related issues.
